entities.name: Lesson
field_behaviors: BO is a view/edit surface for existing lessons.
Lesson code and lesson type are read-only on BO.
Draft and Published lessons remain editable; Completed and Cancelled are not editable.
crud_rules: SF is the source of truth; BO syncs from SF.
Recurring lessons belong to a shared lesson schedule chain.
Opening a lesson on BO uses the selected lesson instance, not the whole chain.

entities.name: Lesson Schedule
field_behaviors: End date is derived from the last lesson in the chain.
Add Lesson and edits can expand or shift chain bounds.
crud_rules: Deleting the last lesson moves the schedule end date back.
This-and-following edits preserve lesson codes and update downstream lessons.
Closed dates can skip generated lessons without leaving code gaps.

entities.name: Lesson Teacher
field_behaviors: Assigned teacher controls BO Calendar visibility for CPU users.
SPU users see lessons by affiliated location.
Cross-location assignment is allowed and preserves access once assigned.
crud_rules: Teacher assignment can happen on lesson detail and list surfaces.
Clashing alerts recalculate on time changes.
BO calendar scope depends on teacher or location access model.

data_relationships: Lesson belongs to a Lesson Schedule chain; adjacent navigation must resolve within the same chain.
Lesson syncs from SF to BO; BO detail visibility depends on assigned teacher or location scope.
Lesson owns Lesson Report and Student Session children; changing the viewed lesson changes downstream report and attendance context.
platform_specific_behaviors: SF is the source of truth and creates/updates lessons; BO consumes synced lesson detail data.
Aver CPU teachers see only lessons where they are assigned as teacher; SPU users see lessons by affiliated location.
Mobile visibility depends on lesson/report publish state, but BO lesson detail remains the operational teaching surface.
non_obvious_edge_cases: First and last lessons in a recurring chain have one missing adjacent neighbor by definition.
One-time lessons have no lesson schedule adjacency unless explicitly duplicated into a chain.
Completed and Cancelled lessons remain viewable in BO when accessible, even though they are not editable.

relevant_features.note: Teacher and staff roles can open BO Lesson Detail.
BO detail already contains interactive action buttons and stateful lesson content.
Aver custom BO lesson/report surfaces already expose partner-specific top-right actions.
